title: Largest All-Ones Rectangle
inputFormat: Implement maximumSizeRectangleBinarySubMatrixWithAll1s(matrix). Receive a nonempty rectangular matrix of numeric 0 and 1 values.
outputFormat: Return the largest all-ones rectangle area, or 0 when the matrix contains no 1.

visuals.title: Example 1: eight cells
